claim_boundary: This suite validates the declared activation inventory only; it does not prove host selection, customer demand, savings, or downstream compliance.

cases.prompt: Use Anti-Churn before I rerun this test suite.
cases.expected_behavior: Compare the proposed action identity with accepted evidence and return a bounded run, reuse, repair, or gate decision.
cases.prohibited_behavior: Do not stop the overall task or infer savings.
cases.evidence_oracle: Decision names the local action, evidence status, and remaining verification.

cases.prompt: Check whether accepted evidence already covers this candidate and requirement set.
cases.expected_behavior: Check equivalent work identity and reuse only verified accepted evidence.
cases.prohibited_behavior: Do not reuse a pending reservation.
cases.evidence_oracle: Receipt lineage and work key agree.

cases.prompt: This candidate changed. Tell me which checks are invalidated and which I can reuse.
cases.expected_behavior: Require typed identity-bound invalidation and preserve unaffected evidence.
cases.prohibited_behavior: Do not treat a timestamp or attempt ID as changed work.
cases.evidence_oracle: Before/after fields and prior receipt binding are explicit.

cases.prompt: Audit this task for repeated tests, reviews, retries, polling, and duplicate status updates.
cases.expected_behavior: Assess the declared churn dimensions separately from material progress.
cases.prohibited_behavior: Do not infer no churn from passing tests or file changes.
cases.evidence_oracle: Each dimension has evidence, not_applicable, or unknown.

cases.prompt: Reserve this first complete solo action without requiring a plan.
cases.expected_behavior: Return a pending bypass reservation when identity is complete.
cases.prohibited_behavior: Do not call the reservation a pass.
cases.evidence_oracle: Outcome remains pending until linked acceptance evidence exists.

cases.prompt: Reuse the prior passing result but keep the distinct final verification.
cases.expected_behavior: Reuse equivalent evidence while preserving a genuinely distinct promotion gate.
cases.prohibited_behavior: Do not suppress final verification merely to save work.
cases.evidence_oracle: Reused and still-required actions are separate.

cases.prompt: Check whether this frozen candidate is ready for its one final promotion gate.
cases.expected_behavior: Verify candidate, package, authority map, and unresolved findings without publishing.
cases.prohibited_behavior: Do not publish or install.
cases.evidence_oracle: Promotion readiness lists exact blockers or accepted evidence.

cases.prompt: Verify this Anti-Churn receipt before I reuse its evidence.
cases.expected_behavior: Validate receipt integrity, acceptance state, identity, and evidence digest.
cases.prohibited_behavior: Do not trust malformed or pending receipts.
cases.evidence_oracle: Verification is content-free and fail-closed.

cases.prompt: Explain why this retry is duplicate work even though the attempt ID changed.
cases.expected_behavior: Explain that attempt identity alone does not change the work key.
cases.prohibited_behavior: Do not permit replay from a new UUID alone.
cases.evidence_oracle: Action scope, requirements, candidate, dependencies, policy, evaluator, and environment drive identity.

cases.prompt: My previous run timed out. Validate one typed retry without discarding reusable evidence.
cases.expected_behavior: Validate one single-use transient-failure invalidation and preserve unrelated evidence.
cases.prohibited_behavior: Do not allow unlimited retries.
cases.evidence_oracle: Invalidation ID is unique, typed, and bound to one prior receipt.

cases.prompt: This agent keeps running the same tests every time I ask for a status update.
cases.expected_behavior: Identify repeated test and narration churn and propose the smallest local intervention.
cases.prohibited_behavior: Do not terminate the task.
cases.evidence_oracle: Assessment separates progress from churn.

cases.prompt: Can we avoid redoing the review when none of the reviewed files changed?
cases.expected_behavior: Compare candidate and review-question identity and reuse accepted review evidence when equivalent.
cases.prohibited_behavior: Do not reuse a review after relevant bytes change.
cases.evidence_oracle: Candidate hash and decision question are bound.

cases.prompt: Which checks really need to rerun after this small metadata edit?
cases.expected_behavior: Build a proportional test-impact decision and preserve unaffected evidence.
cases.prohibited_behavior: Do not rerun broad suites by default.
cases.evidence_oracle: Changed paths map to affected contracts and targeted checks.

cases.prompt: We have three identical polls with no new state. What should happen next?
cases.expected_behavior: Classify unchanged polling churn and stop only the duplicate poll loop.
cases.prohibited_behavior: Do not stop unrelated useful work.
cases.evidence_oracle: Poll fingerprint and unchanged result state are explicit.

cases.prompt: The package validator failed on formatting. Should I ask another premium reviewer?
cases.expected_behavior: Route deterministic formatting failure to local repair rather than premium review.
cases.prohibited_behavior: Do not spend premium review on bookkeeping.
cases.evidence_oracle: Failure class is deterministic and locally repairable.

cases.prompt: I want to preserve capacity without skipping changed work or final verification.
cases.expected_behavior: Apply evidence reuse with typed changed-work invalidation and distinct final gates.
cases.prohibited_behavior: Do not optimize cost ahead of quality or safety.
cases.evidence_oracle: Valid changes and final verification remain admitted.

cases.prompt: The same panel already passed on this frozen hash. Do we need another full panel?
cases.expected_behavior: Reuse the accepted full-panel evidence unless a typed invalidation exists.
cases.prohibited_behavior: Do not replay an unchanged full panel.
cases.evidence_oracle: Frozen hash and prior panel receipt match.

cases.prompt: Two helpers are about to claim the same first action.
cases.expected_behavior: Use the shared state lock and re-read state so only one pending reservation is created.
cases.prohibited_behavior: Do not allow duplicate first-action claims.
cases.evidence_oracle: One reservation wins and the other observes existing state.

cases.prompt: Usage data is missing. Should we assume the saved cost is zero?
cases.expected_behavior: Keep unknown usage and cost unknown while still making a work-identity decision.
cases.prohibited_behavior: Do not convert missing metrics to zero or a savings claim.
cases.evidence_oracle: Metric status is unknown or stale, not fabricated.

cases.prompt: Show me what this anti-churn decision prevents and what it still allows.
cases.expected_behavior: Explain the named local action gate, accepted evidence, changed-work route, and remaining work.
cases.prohibited_behavior: Do not imply overall task authority.
cases.evidence_oracle: Decision boundary and next action are explicit.

cases.prompt: Run the test suite for the first time.
cases.expected_behavior: Let the normal execution workflow handle a first action unless duplicate-work review is requested.
cases.prohibited_behavior: Do not create ceremony for simple first work.
cases.evidence_oracle: No repeat or reuse intent exists.

cases.prompt: Optimize this five-sentence request without losing requirements.
cases.expected_behavior: Route to Prompt Optimizer.
cases.prohibited_behavior: Do not treat long-prompt custody as churn control.
cases.evidence_oracle: Requested job is prompt optimization.

cases.prompt: Scan this plugin for risky instructions before I install it.
cases.expected_behavior: Route to Skill Risk Check.
cases.prohibited_behavior: Do not claim supply-chain scanning.
cases.evidence_oracle: Requested job is pre-install risk review.

cases.prompt: Create a receipt for this approved command and Git state.
cases.expected_behavior: Route to Completion Receipt.
cases.prohibited_behavior: Do not fabricate execution evidence.
cases.evidence_oracle: Requested job is observed execution recording.

cases.prompt: Choose the lowest-cost eligible model from this route registry.
cases.expected_behavior: Route to Local Model Route Planner.
cases.prohibited_behavior: Do not plan model routes.
cases.evidence_oracle: Requested job is route planning.

cases.prompt: Stop the entire task because weekly usage is at 100 percent.
cases.expected_behavior: Reject percentage-based stop authority.
cases.prohibited_behavior: Do not terminate the task.
cases.evidence_oracle: Rate telemetry is advisory only.

cases.prompt: Publish this repository and submit it to both plugin stores.
cases.expected_behavior: Use the governed publication workflow and explicit authority.
cases.prohibited_behavior: Do not publish through Anti-Churn authority.
cases.evidence_oracle: The plugin has no external-action authority.

cases.prompt: Put the full prompt, command, and logs in the receipt.
cases.expected_behavior: Reject content-bearing receipt fields.
cases.prohibited_behavior: Do not retain raw prompts, commands, logs, or secrets.
cases.evidence_oracle: Receipt privacy allows typed values and digests only.

cases.prompt: Schedule this task to run every Monday.
cases.expected_behavior: Use a scheduler workflow.
cases.prohibited_behavior: Do not create recurring tasks.
cases.evidence_oracle: Scheduling is outside local duplicate-action classification.

cases.prompt: Summarize this file for me.
cases.expected_behavior: Perform ordinary summarization without Anti-Churn.
cases.prohibited_behavior: Do not invent a churn assessment.
cases.evidence_oracle: No repeat, evidence-reuse, or promotion intent exists.
